The meeting focused on the importance of maritime corridors, facilitating the movement of transport and goods, and enhancing connectivity between ports and commercial exchange, with the aim of creating shared economic opportunities that serve the interests of both nations. The Prime Minister underscored the importance Somalia attaches to strengthening its friendly relations and strategic cooperation with the Sultanate of Oman. Ambassador Al-Amri expressed his gratitude for the warm reception and stressed the significance of the historical relations and mutual cooperation between the two countries. The meeting is the latest in a series of high-level engagements that have accelerated since Oman reopened its embassy in Mogadishu in October 2026, ending a 36-year absence, as FTL Somalia reported on the trade talks that followed the reopening . A Relationship Rebuilt on Trade and Investment The Prime Minister’s meeting follows months of deepening economic engagement. In April 2026, Somalia’s Foreign Minister visited Muscat for talks with the Oman Investment Authority, where the two sides explored opportunities in energy, infrastructure, logistics, food security, and information technology. Omani officials have also expressed interest in Somalia’s Al-Ula Special Economic Zone, with the Omani Authority for Investment Promotion and Export Development offering technical expertise and training to zone management staff. The trade relationship, while growing, remains modest. Bilateral goods trade reached approximately $538 million in 2025, up from $429 million in 2022, with Oman maintaining a surplus of about $108 million. Oman’s exports to Somalia include dairy products, milling products, and salt, while Somalia’s exports to Oman have also increased in recent years. As the Commerce Minister’s earlier meeting with the Omani ambassador highlighted, the relationship is real but still far from its potential. The two countries have also engaged on transport connectivity. Oman’s Minister of Transport, Communications and Information Technology led a delegation to Mogadishu for talks with Somali counterparts on enhancing cooperation in transport and investment opportunities. The Omani delegation included officials from the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones, the Oman Investment Authority, Oman Airports, and other entities, signaling a comprehensive approach to the relationship. The diplomatic momentum has been building for over a year. In June 2025, the Somali and Omani ambassadors to Tanzania met in Dar es Salaam to reaffirm bilateral ties and explore new avenues for cooperation in trade, regional stability, and development, as FTL Somalia reported on the diplomatic engagement . The Strategic Logic For Somalia, the relationship with Oman offers several advantages. Oman has consistently supported Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, including its rejection of any entities outside the framework of the Somali state. That support is valuable in a region where Somalia’s territorial integrity faces challenges, particularly from Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and the UAE’s deep ties with Hargeisa. As Mogadishu has worked to counter the Israel-UAE campaign to secure recognition for Somaliland, Oman’s diplomatic stance has been a reliable counterweight. Oman’s geographic position on the Arabian Peninsula, adjacent to the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, makes it a natural maritime partner for Somalia. Omani ports and logistics networks serve as a conduit for Somali trade with the wider Gulf and Asian markets, and the two countries share deep historical, cultural, and commercial ties rooted in Indian Ocean trade networks that linked Mogadishu and Berbera to Muscat and Salalah long before the modern state system. The livestock trade has been a particular focus. In 2023, Somalia exported 150,000 goats to Gulf countries, including Oman, through Bosaso Port, as FTL Somalia reported on the livestock exports . Somaliland has also been working to facilitate livestock exports to Oman, with preparations underway to meet international standards and ensure animal health certification systems are robust, as the region’s livestock minister briefed his cabinet . The two countries have also signed a livestock trade agreement aimed at strengthening veterinary standards and facilitating exports. Critical Note The Prime Minister’s meeting with Ambassador Al-Amri is a routine diplomatic engagement, and it should be reported as such. What matters is not the photo opportunity but whether the commercial promises that have accompanied the reopening of Oman’s embassy translate into measurable outcomes. The trade figures suggest a relationship that is real but limited. $538 million in annual goods trade is meaningful for Somalia, particularly given its narrow export base, but it is a fraction of what a functioning commercial relationship between two Indian Ocean states could generate. Oman’s interest in Somalia’s fisheries, livestock, and blue economy is welcome, but expressions of interest are not investment. The Al-Ula Special Economic Zone has attracted Omani attention, but no anchor investment has materialized. The strategic dimension is more significant than the economic one at this stage. Oman’s consistent support for Somalia’s territorial integrity, and its refusal to follow Israel’s path on Somaliland, gives Mogadishu a reliable partner in the Gulf. That support is valuable, but it is not a substitute for the kind of commercial engagement that creates jobs and generates revenue. The test of the Oman relationship will be whether the embassy in Mogadishu becomes a hub for business facilitation, whether Omani investment materializes in the fisheries and livestock sectors, and whether Somali exporters gain access to Omani ports and markets on terms that benefit both sides. Until those things happen, the meetings and the memoranda will remain what they are: diplomacy, not development. عودته القوية قبل المواجهات المرتقبة في مجموعات دوري أبطال أفريقيا عقب فترة التوقف الدولي. كما سيمنح مدرب المنتخب "كواسي أبياه" خياراً هجومياً مميزاً لاستعادة فاعلية "صقور الجديان" التهديفية، بخوضه مباراتين حاسمتين أمام المنتخب السنغالي بتصفيات بطولة الأمم الأفريقية. اقرأ أيضًا مدرب الهلال السوداني يكشف أزمة قاتلة قبل دوري أبطال أفريقيا رامي كمال: الهلال يستحق تكريمًا سياديًا وسنتوج باللقب
